observedMessage: The runner returned malformed output: its Commands omitted the required absolute official preflight command. No attempt, PASS, findings, or Effective Validation Base was created.
rootCause: The runner repeatedly treated the launcher-owned official preflight as a model-serialized command. The semantic response used an incomplete alias/placeholder instead of the exact absolute invocation, so the strict validation boundary correctly blocked before creating an attempt or candidate.
responsibleBoundary: VALIDATE_SLICE semantic-response producer and its runner contract
correctionPlan: Keep the semantic runner commands model-owned, reject semantic preflight attempts, and deterministically derive and prepend the exact official preflight command from the supplied SPEC_PATH and numeric slice before candidate validation.

evidence.workspace: preserved managed workspace outside repository; not copied here
